mapper.select: SELECT M.MENUID,M.MLEVEL,M.MNAME,M.MSEQUENCE,M.MURL,M.PARENTID,M.MICON,M.MTYPE,M.MCODE,MM.MENUID1,MM.PARENTID1,MM.MNAME1,MM.MSEQUENCE1,MM.MCODE1,MM.MENUID2,MM.PARENTID2,MM.MNAME2,MM.MSEQUENCE2,MM.MCODE2 FROM T_ECC_MENU M LEFT JOIN (SELECT M1.MENUID MENUID1,M1.PARENTID PARENTID1,M1.MNAME MNAME1,M1.MSEQUENCE MSEQUENCE1,M1.STATUS STATUS1,M1.MCODE MCODE1,M2.MENUID MENUID2,M2.PARENTID PARENTID2,M2.MNAME MNAME2,M2.MSEQUENCE MSEQUENCE2,M2.STATUS STATUS2,M2.MCODE MCODE2 FROM T_ECC_MENU M1 LEFT JOIN T_ECC_MENU M2 on M1.MENUID=M2.PARENTID AND M1.MTYPE='0' AND M2.MTYPE='0' AND M2.STATUS='1' WHERE M1.STATUS='1' ) MM ON M.MENUID=MM.PARENTID1 AND MM.STATUS1='1' WHERE M.PARENTID=0 AND M.STATUS='1'
SELECT M.MENUID,M.MLEVEL,M.MNAME,M.MSEQUENCE,M.MURL,M.PARENTID,M.MICON,M.MTYPE FROM T_ECC_MENU M WHERE M.PARENTID=#{parentId}
SELECT M.MENUID,M.MLEVEL,M.MNAME,M.MSEQUENCE,M.MURL,M.PARENTID,M.MDESC,M.MCODE,M.MICON,M.MTYPE FROM T_ECC_MENU M WHERE M.MENUID=#{menuId}
SELECT M.MENUID,M.MLEVEL,M.MNAME,M.MSEQUENCE,M.MURL,M.PARENTID,M.MDESC,M.MCODE,M.MICON,M.MTYPE FROM T_ECC_MENU M WHERE M.MURL=#{url}
SELECT M.MENUID,M.MLEVEL,M.MNAME,M.MSEQUENCE,M.MURL,M.PARENTID,M.MDESC,M.MCODE,M.MICON,M.MTYPE FROM T_ECC_MENU M WHERE M.STATUS='1' ORDER BY M.MSEQUENCE
SELECT MAX(M.MSEQUENCE)+1 AS NEXT_SEQUENCE FROM T_ECC_MENU M
SELECT M.MENUID,M.MLEVEL,M.MNAME,M.MSEQUENCE,M.MURL,M.PARENTID,M.MICON,M.MTYPE FROM T_ECC_MENU M WHERE M.MNAME LIKE '%'||#{menuNM}||'%'

SELECT COUNT(1) AS COUNT FROM T_ECC_MENU M WHERE M.STATUS = '1' AND M.MTYPE='0' AND M.MNAME=#{menuNM}
AND M.MENUID <> #{menuId}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS COUNT FROM T_ECC_MENU M WHERE M.STATUS = '1' AND M.MURL=#{url}
AND M.MENUID <> #{menuId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM T_ECC_MENU M WHERE M.MTYPE='0' AND M.STATUS = '1' AND M.PARENTID=#{parentId}

SELECT M.MENUID,M.MLEVEL,M.MNAME,M.MSEQUENCE,M.MURL,M.PARENTID,M.MDESC,M.MCODE,M.MICON,M.MTYPE FROM T_ECC_ORMEMBER O JOIN T_ECC_ORMEMBER_MENU OM ON O.ORGID=OM.ORGID AND O.TITLEID=OM.TITLEID AND OM.STATUS='1' AND O.STAT='STAR' JOIN T_ECC_MENU M ON M.MENUID=OM.MENUID WHERE M.STATUS = '1' AND O.EMPID=#{empId}

SELECT M.MENUID,M.MLEVEL,M.MNAME,M.MSEQUENCE,M.MURL,M.PARENTID,M.MDESC,M.MCODE,M.MICON,M.MTYPE FROM T_ECC_EMP_MENU EM JOIN T_ECC_MENU M ON M.MENUID = EM.MENUID WHERE M.MTYPE='1' AND M.STATUS = '1' AND EM.EMPID=#{empId}
SELECT M.MENUID,M.MLEVEL,M.MNAME,M.MSEQUENCE,M.MURL,M.PARENTID,M.MDESC,M.MCODE,M.MICON,M.MTYPE FROM T_ECC_MENU M WHERE M.MCODE = #{code}
mapper.update:
UPDATE T_ECC_MENU M SET M.MLEVEL = #{level}, M.MNAME = #{name}, M.MSEQUENCE = #{sequence}, M.MURL = #{url}, M.PARENTID = #{parentId}, M.MDESC = #{desc} , M.MCODE = #{code} , M.MICON = #{icon}, M.MTYPE = #{type}
M.MENUID = #{menuId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') || LPAD(SEQ_MENU_NO.NEXTVAL, 6, '0') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO T_ECC_MENU( MENUID , MLEVEL , MNAME , MSEQUENCE, MURL , PARENTID , MDESC , MCODE , MICON , MTYPE , STATUS , CREATEID , CREATETIME ) VALUES( #{menuId}, #{level}, #{name}, #{sequence}, #{url}, #{parentId}, #{desc}, #{code}, #{icon}, #{type}, #{status}, #{createId}, SYSDATE )
